question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Live.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in **blank no. 4** is** "live."**
 
• The sentence talks about the rarity of dolphins in fresh water, rivers, and lakes, which suggests that most dolphins live in the sea.
 
• Therefore, the word** "live"** fits in the context of the sentence.
 
• **Example sentence:**
 
 
• Bottlenose dolphins are known to **live **in both shallow and deep waters along coastlines, bays, and estuaries.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

Correct Paragraph:__ *Whales and dolphins are (1) __considered__ to be very unusual creatures. Do you know they breathe air and are warm-blooded? The (2) __reason__ for them being warm-blooded is because of their belonging to the mammal group. They mostly eat other animals as their (3) __prey__. Most of these animals live in the sea. There are very rare and few dolphins in the world which (4) __live__ in fresh water, rivers and lakes. These animals or marine mammals have many records to their (5) ________, the biggest animal in the world and the largest hunter. These mammals are some of the fastest, deepest, diving and cleverest creatures.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
• **"Exits"** is a verb that means to go out or leave a place. It is not appropriate in the context of the sentence because it does not convey the idea of where dolphins live.
 
 
• Example sentence: He **exits **the building every day at 5 PM.
 
 
 
• **"Settle"** is a verb that means to make a home or establish oneself in a new place. While it is similar in meaning to "live," it is not appropriate in the context of the sentence because it implies a more deliberate choice or action than what is described.
 
 
• Example sentence: After years of traveling, she decided to **settle **down in a small town in the mountains.
 
 
 
• **"Life"** is a noun that means the condition that distinguishes living things from non-living things, or the existence of an individual organism. It is not appropriate in the context of the sentence because it does not convey the idea of where dolphins are found.
 
 
• Example sentence: The diversity of **life **on Earth is truly remarkable.
